purpose: Mechanically bind every selected audit item to fixed public source and extract reproducible visible context. This artifact contains no audit verdict.

locator.file: Use the canonical inventory section only. Reject absolute paths, parent traversal, unsupported components, missing git objects and DLC files escaping their registered root.
locator.match: Find every whitespace-normalized literal occurrence of the complete selected English source. Treat actual whitespace and Lua escaped newline, carriage-return or tab sequences as one space.
locator.context: For each occurrence, retain 12 complete source lines before and after the matched span, capped deterministically at 12000 characters while retaining the entire matched span.
locator.multiple_occurrences: Record every occurrence. Do not choose one occurrence or infer equivalence mechanically.
locator.missing_policy: A failed binding or zero occurrence is a locator failure. Preserve it in the output; do not replace the selected item and do not convert it into an audit verdict.

statuses.LOCATED_UNIQUE: The registered file was bound and contains exactly one normalized occurrence.
statuses.LOCATED_MULTIPLE: The registered file was bound and contains more than one normalized occurrence; all occurrences are retained for audit.
statuses.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The registered file was bound but contains no normalized occurrence.
statuses.SOURCE_FILE_MISSING: The canonical section did not resolve to a readable registered source artifact.
statuses.SOURCE_BINDING_FAILED: The fixed git object, DLC root or safety invariant could not be verified.
statuses.UNSUPPORTED_COMPONENT: No binding exists for the canonical component.

non_judgment_invariants: Do not write CONFIRMED, REFUTED, INDETERMINATE or UNREACHABLE.
Do not write defect identifiers, audit reasons or corrections.
Do not call a model or expose this artifact to reviewer routes.
Do not embed local absolute paths in generated artifacts.
